heading: FIFA World Cup 2026 schedule — Complete list of matches, dates, venues kick-off timings in IST, live streaming info
author: Team Sportstar
paragraphs: Updated : Jun 04, 2026 13:31 IST , Chennai - 1 MIN READ
The 2026 edition of FIFA World Cup will have a record 48 teams competing for the coveted trophy, with Argentina entering the competition as the defending champion. | Photo Credit: AP
The FIFA World Cup 2026 is just a week away, and the preparations of all participating teams are in their final phase.

Despite some controversies regarding the participation of Iran – owing to the West Asian conflict – and DR Congo – due to Ebola outbreak – all teams have finally confirmed that they will play in the ‘greatest show on earth’.
Sportstar looks at the complete schedule of the FIFA World Cup 2026, with kick-off timings in local time and IST.
The FIFA World Cup 2026, the 23rd edition of the tournament is scheduled in the United States of America, Mexico and Canada, between June 11 and July 19.
In India, the match will be telecast on United8 Sports, while it can be live-streamed on ZEE5.
